description: Discover available eSIM regions, including worldwide scopes, with their canonical slugs, display names, member countries and starting prices. Only published regions with active displayed regional plans are listed. Pass a returned region slug to list-plans as region, not destination. Country membership describes the region, not a promise that every plan covers every member: check get-plan-coverage for a specific plan. Read-only; no account or key is needed.

currency.description: Optional. ISO 4217 code for starting prices, e.g. "EUR" or "USD". Defaults to EUR; unknown codes fall back to the base currency.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum regions to return, 1 to 300. Defaults to 300. total reports the match count before this limit.

search.description: Optional. Case-insensitive partial match on the canonical region slug or display name, e.g. "asia". Omit to list all available regions.

name: list-regions

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for all starting prices.

regions.description: Available regions in storefront order. Empty when nothing matches.

countries.description: Region membership as ISO2 codes, not the coverage of any one plan. Empty for worldwide scopes.

countries_count.description: Region size by catalog taxonomy. Do not use this as an individual plan coverage count.

from_price_cents.description: Cheapest displayed regional plan price in minor units of currency, e.g. 1250 means EUR 12.50 when currency is EUR.

plan_countries_count.description: Widest single plan coverage. Say "up to" this many countries; the cheapest plan may cover fewer.

region.description: Canonical slug to pass to list-plans.region.

returned.description: Number of regions in this response.

title: List eSIM regions
